data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 frames the panel's reliability as an 'illusion of precision'—being highly reliable at solving the checklist version of the problem—but never specifies what evidence within a single evaluation would separate this illusion from a genuine reliability gain. The problem demands a criterion for distinguishing genuine gain from mere compliance that happens to track the right answer; SRC_003 merely asserts the panel's success is illusory without supplying the discriminating evidence the problem requires.
